title: Best AI Model for Coding in 2026: Claude, GPT-4o, and Gemini Compared
summary: Claude Sonnet 4.5 leads agentic coding at 77.2% SWE-bench. GPT-4o wins for IDE integration. Gemini 1.5 Pro dominates long context for free. 2026 benchmarks and pricing.
body_markdown: SWE-bench Verified is a benchmark where AI models must resolve 500 real GitHub issues — actual pull requests from open-source repositories — without human help. It's the most realistic measure of autonomous coding ability currently available. A model that scores 77% on SWE-bench solves roughly 385 of those 500 issues on its own; a model at 38% solves 190. The gap is meaningful in production agentic workflows.
